paper_title: Multi-k-ic Depth Three Circuit Lower Bound
statement: from our work is multi-k-ic formulas: Let x be a variable and g be a gate. The formal degree of x at g, denoted degx (g), is defined as follows. If g is a ×-gate with children g1 and g2 then degx (g) = degx (g1 ) + degx (g2 ). If g is a +-gate with children g1 and g2 then degx (g) = max{degx (g1 ), degx (g2 )}. If g is an input gate labelled with x then degx (g) = 1, otherwise degx (g) = 0. A formula is multi-k-ic if for every variable x and every gate g, the formal degree of x at g is bounded by k. Can we prove super-polynomial lower bounds for constant depth multi-k-ic formulas? Can we prove super-polynomial lower bounds for multi-k-ic formulas?
